remarks: Welcome home to this charming 2-Bedroom Starter Home in a Great Neighborhood! Professional photos to follow. This cute and inviting 2-bedroom, 1¼-bath home offers 1,156 square feet of comfortable living space on a spacious 7,740-square-foot lot. Perfect for first-time buyers, downsizers, or anyone looking for a home with room to grow, this property combines charm, functionality, and a fantastic location. The home features a 2-car garage plus a detached, roofed shed with windows, offering excellent flexibility for a workshop, hobby space, storage, or creative retreat. The generous lot provides plenty of potential for outdoor enjoyment, gardening, entertaining, or future improvements.
